== Description ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] (front left, navy Lincoln Financial pullover), [[Ming Huo]] (front right, grey tee), [[Garrett Larson]] (middle-left table behind Scott, pink cap, beard), [[Nathan Davis]] (back middle-right, blue/yellow M cap, black hoodie, beard), [[Mike Turner]] (back middle-right behind Nathan Davis, tan cap, black hoodie), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (back far right facing left, black graphic tee, white cargo shorts, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
